name: 38. OpenAI Encrypted Reasoning Item ID Round-Trip via Anthropic Surface (#5186 / PR #5192)
description: Regression coverage for #5186 (PR #5192 addresses it upstream; this harness pins the black-box symptom, not any specific internal fix): OpenAI's Responses API cryptographically binds a reasoning item's encrypted_content to the id it was issued with. Anthropic's wire format has no id field on thinking/redacted_thinking content blocks, so when Bifrost's /anthropic/v1/messages surface converts an OpenAI reasoning item for the client it drops the real id, and when the client echoes the block back on a follow-up turn Bifrost previously minted a fresh random id while forwarding the original (still real) encrypted_content - a mismatch OpenAI rejects with "The encrypted content for item rs_... could not be verified. Reason: Encrypted content item_id did not match the target item id." All three cases force reasoning.encrypted_content via include so the repro is deterministic rather than relying on undocumented spontaneous attachment. Case 1 pins the streaming emission; case 2 pins the non-streaming baseline and captures the replay content into a collection variable; case 3 replays the redacted_thinking block on a follow-up turn, which 400s pre-fix.

item.name: openai/gpt-5 /anthropic/v1/messages streaming carries encrypted reasoning as redacted_thinking block - #5186

exec: pm.test('Streaming reasoning carries a thinking/redacted_thinking content block - #5186', function () {
pm.expect(body, 'expected a thinking or redacted_thinking content block').to.match(/"type":\s*"(redacted_)?thinking"/);

body.raw: {"model":"openai/gpt-5","max_tokens":4096,"stream":true,"thinking":{"type":"enabled","budget_tokens":2048},"include":["reasoning.encrypted_content"],"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Think hard: which two of Alpha, Beta, Gamma, Delta are adjacent Greek letters whose English spellings share no vowels? Just name them."}]}

item.name: openai/gpt-5 /anthropic/v1/messages non-streaming preserves encrypted reasoning + captures replay content - #5186

exec: pm.test('Non-streaming response succeeds and returns content - #5186', function () {
pm.test('Non-streaming response carries encrypted reasoning as redacted_thinking - #5186', function () {
var redacted = content.filter(function (c) { return c.type === 'redacted_thinking' && c.data; });
pm.expect(redacted, 'expected a redacted_thinking block with non-empty data, got: ' + JSON.stringify(content.map(function (c) { return c.type; }))).to.not.be.empty;
// Capture the replay content for the next request only when a redacted_thinking
// block with non-empty data is actually present, so the replay case skips
// instead of false-failing when the model didn't produce encrypted content.

body.raw: {"model":"openai/gpt-5","max_tokens":4096,"thinking":{"type":"enabled","budget_tokens":2048},"include":["reasoning.encrypted_content"],"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Think hard: which two of Alpha, Beta, Gamma, Delta are adjacent Greek letters whose English spellings share no vowels? Just name them."}]}

item.name: openai/gpt-5 /anthropic/v1/messages replay of encrypted reasoning accepted (no item_id mismatch) - #5186

exec: // Skip when the capture step did not run or found no redacted_thinking block:
// the body placeholder stays unresolved, so there is nothing to replay.
pm.test('Replayed encrypted reasoning accepted without item_id mismatch - #5186', function () {
pm.expect(body, 'OpenAI rejected the replayed reasoning item (regression of #5186)').to.not.include('did not match the target item id');
pm.expect(body, 'OpenAI rejected the replayed reasoning item (regression of #5186)').to.not.include('could not be verified');
